title: Cosmo offers an install when an installed model already does the job
description: Live 2026-10-29: asked for a picture from a video frame with Klein 9B and Qwen-Image 2.1 installed, Cosmo put up an Install Krea 2 card (19.5 GB). install_model refuses when the user never named the model and an installed, free, runnable op already covers every task the model is ranked for. Also re-ranks image tasks: Krea 2, Qwen-Image 2.1, FLUX.3 Klein, then the rest (Fabio 2026-10-29).
